title: 4권 0유닛 스토리북 · 2쪽
prompt: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. Bright cheerful palette (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky blue). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene: the background is made of a few large flat color shapes (ground, bushes, sky) with a calm plain sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. Letter trees are ordinary round leafy trees with small fruits (like an orchard); never shape trees, clouds, paths or any object like letters of the alphabet. One single continuous picture: never split it into panels, frames or a collage, and draw each character only once. Full-page picture-book illustration. Use the attached character sheet ONLY to copy how the characters look. Draw ONLY these characters: Pip, Bun, Hedgie, Grumble, Beads, Fairy E. Every other character on the sheet must NOT appear in this picture. Scene: Fairy E, a tiny palm-sized glowing fairy with bubble wings and a star-tipped wand, bursts out of a swirl of golden sparkles at the end of the wooden sign above the gate (carved with c, a, p — the ONLY text allowed in the picture) and circles Pip, giggling; Pip stares, amazed; Bun and Hedgie lean in; Beads's antennae stand up. High in a round tower window, the tip of Grumble's striped nightcap and his frowning face peek out, one paw at his mouth. Characters: Pip is a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf. Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small round hedgehog with BRIGHT ORANGE spikes (never brown), a peach-colored face and cream belly, standing on two legs, one tiny blue flower stuck in the spikes, curious cautious eyes. Grumble is a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers. Beads is a small friendly caterpillar whose body is a string of five round beads in rainbow colors (red, orange, yellow, green, blue), big round sparkling eyes, two tiny antennae tipped with little beads, a cheerful open smile, no letters on the beads. Fairy E is a tiny palm-sized fairy glowing with soft golden light, a round rosy face with big sparkling eyes, short wavy lilac hair, a little dress made of pale-green leaf petals, two round see-through wings like soap bubbles, holding a thin wand tipped with a small yellow star, no letters or symbols drawn anywhere on her or her wand.
